It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. - Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

  "2D": {
    "x0": <x0_value>,
    "gamma": <gamma_value>,
    "amplitude": <amplitude_value>,
    "offset": <offset_value>"
  }
}
